app.name: CVApp
app.tagline: Build a CV you're proud of

landing.point1Body: As many CVs as you like, and as many downloads.
landing.point2Body: Selectable text that the applicant tracking systems employers use can read.
landing.point3Body: Write your CV in one language while the app is in another.

beta.bannerTitle: CVApp is in beta — and free
beta.bannerBody: Everything works, and you can build and download as many CVs as you like without paying. Later there will be a small charge to cover server and database costs. Anything you make now is yours, and comes with you.
beta.thanksTitle: Your CV is on its way
beta.thanksFree: CVApp is free while in beta. Later it will cost a small amount to cover server and database costs — what you have made comes with you.
beta.feedbackPrompt: Got 20 seconds? Tell us what worked or what annoyed you.
beta.feedbackPlaceholder: The thing that surprised me was …
beta.sent: Thank you — that helps more than you think.
beta.noDestination: Feedback is not wired to a destination yet.

auth.signInLead: Your CVs then follow you between your phone and your computer. Everything you have made stays.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is not switched on yet. Your CVs are saved on this device.
